Context: today a set of redesigned templates were built as internal preview routes under `app/(marketing)/preview/*` (noindex, never live) so the owner could review before committing. The owner has now approved migrating them all onto the real live pages. One migration (mods page) is already done as your reference pattern — read `app/(marketing)/game-servers/mods/page.tsx` (the now-migrated live page) to see the established approach: render the new template component with real content, but KEEP/UPGRADE the live page's existing SEO metadata (title, description, canonical, OG tags) and structured data (JSON-LD) rather than using the preview route's placeholder noindex metadata. Also check if the live page fetches real dynamic data (e.g. real review-badge aggregation via a `ReviewBadges` component) that the preview route mocked — if so, wire the real fetch into the migrated page, don't downgrade to mock/fallback data.

Your scope — migrate these "core services" pages, each preview→live pair (read `app/(marketing)/preview/page.tsx` for the full list/descriptions if you need context on what each template looks like):

1. `preview/vps` (`VpsLanding.tsx`) → live page is `/vps` (find exact path: `app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx` or similar)
2. `preview/web-hosting` (`WebHostingTemplate.tsx`) → live `/web-hosting`
3. `preview/business-email` (`EmailLanding.tsx`) → live `/business-email`
4. `preview/domains` (`DomainsLanding.tsx`) → live `/domains`
5. `preview/nxcloud` (`NxCloudLanding.tsx`) → live `/nxcloud`
6. `preview/ai-hosting` (`AIHostingTemplate.tsx`) → find the live equivalent page (search for an existing AI/vibe-coding hosting page — may be `/vibe-coding` per the sitemap, or may not exist live yet, in which case this becomes a NEW page, not a migration — check `app/sitemap.ts` at /opt/nxeon-staging for the exact existing route)
7. `preview/app-hosting` (`GhostVpsLanding.tsx`) → this preview demos "Ghost" as the example self-hosted app; find if a live `/host-ghost-on-a-vps` or similar single-app-hosting page already exists as a pattern (check sitemap for existing "-hosting" or app-specific routes like `wordpress-vps-hosting`, `n8n-hosting`, etc.) — if `GhostVpsLanding.tsx` is actually a reusable single-app-hosting template (check if it takes an app-identity prop or is hardcoded to Ghost), figure out whether it should replace ONE existing app-hosting page as a 1:1 migration, or if it's meant as the new shared pattern for ALL the app-hosting pages (wordpress-vps-hosting, docker-hosting, n8n-hosting, nodejs-hosting, nextcloud-hosting, vpn-server-hosting, discord-bot-hosting — check `app/sitemap.ts` for the full list). If it's the latter (a reusable pattern), migrate at least the Ghost-equivalent live page 1:1 first and clearly report that the others are a larger follow-up (don't try to rebuild 7+ pages in this pass unless it's trivially mechanical — report your judgment).

For EACH page: read the live page's current metadata/structured-data/internal-links first, read the template + its data file, rewrite the live page to render the new template with the real content while preserving/upgrading SEO value, clean up now-unused old imports, and run `npx tsc --noEmit` after each one (don't let errors compound across pages — fix as you go).

Do NOT touch the preview routes — leave them as-is. Do NOT touch game-landing templates or the blog/comparison/free-tier/location/tool templates — those are being handled by a separate task in parallel.

Report back per-page (table format, under 500 words): migrated cleanly / needs-owner-decision / became-new-page, any content/links from the old page that didn't have an obvious home in the new template (flag, don't drop silently), and final `tsc` status.
